prompts.title: Colorful Scribble Art Family Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-detailed hand-drawn scribble-art portrait using the uploaded family photo only as the reference for each person’s facial identity, age, gender, skin tone, hairstyle, and family members. Include exactly the same 3 or 4 people—do not add, remove, replace, or merge anyone. Do not copy the original pose, composition, background, or exact clothing.
Create a fresh, professionally arranged family pose. Place the entire family prominently in the center of a vertical composition, close together with warm, natural interaction. Position the parents behind or beside the children, gently leaning inward. For one child, place them centrally between or slightly in front of the parents; an infant or toddler may be held naturally. For two children of any age or gender, arrange both clearly in the center foreground or between the parents with balanced spacing and every face fully visible. Give everyone warm, natural expressions directed toward the viewer.
Restyle the family in coordinated, elegant outfits suitable for their age, gender, and cultural appearance. If the reference clothing is very simple, enhance it with richer colors, tasteful patterns, refined fabric details, subtle embroidery, layering, or appropriate accessories. The outfits should look stylish and complementary without becoming overly formal. Do not reproduce the exact original clothes.
Render the portrait using thousands of overlapping, free-flowing thin pen strokes and colorful ink scribbles in black, blue, orange, pink, purple, and red. Preserve recognizable facial features, realistic anatomy, expressive eyes, intricate crosshatching, delicate shading, and accurate proportions.
Use clean white textured paper as the background. Keep the family sharply detailed and fully defined at the center, while the outer edges of their clothing and surrounding linework gradually dissolve into loose, colorful scribbles and softly fade into the white background on both sides. Maintain balanced negative space around the centered family.
Eye-level medium family portrait, gallery-quality traditional pen-and-ink illustration, vibrant artistic energy, ultra-sharp detail, vertical composition. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Joyful Family of Three in Color
prompts.prompt: Create an ultra-detailed hand-drawn scribble art portrait of a happy family featuring a smiling father, mother, and baby posing closely together. Composition: medium family portrait in a centered vertical composition, with the baby positioned in the foreground and the parents leaning their heads together behind the child, filling the frame naturally with balanced spacing and a warm, intimate arrangement. The father has a well-groomed appearance, and wears a casual pink T-shirt. The mother has long hair, a small bindi, elegant earrings, and wears a vibrant yellow floral traditional outfit while lovingly holding the baby. The baby wears a light-colored floral sleeveless romper and looks directly at the camera with a curious expression. All three subjects smile warmly toward the viewer. Camera angle: eye-level perspective with a natural portrait framing. Render the artwork using thousands of overlapping free-flowing thin pen strokes and colorful ink scribbles in black, blue, orange, pink, purple, and red, blending into expressive abstract line work. Keep the background as clean white textured paper with subtle colorful scribble accents surrounding the subjects. Emphasize realistic facial features, expressive eyes, extreme line detailing, layered crosshatching, delicate shading, and vibrant artistic energy while preserving accurate anatomy and proportions. High-detail traditional pen-and-ink illustration, gallery-quality, ultra-sharp, 8K resolution, vertical composition. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: The Scribble Sketch Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create a 8K highly detailed head-and-neck portrait illustration of a person. Use the attached image as the ONLY face-matching reference.
Composition:
The composition includes the subject's head and shoulders, perfectly composed and perfectly centered. Maintain balanced negative space around the head and hair. The subject is looking directly into the camera with a strict eye-level, front-facing angle (no tilt). Expression should be calm, composed, and with lips gently closed. The subject is wearing a simple black round neck T-shirt, visible only at the shoulders and neckline.
Art Style:
Render the artwork as a raw, chaotic ink-style poster, constructed primarily from dense, curved black scribble strokes. The reference image is used strictly for accurate structure and likeness—do not stylize beyond recognition.
Line Work & Form:
Build hair, facial shadows, and depth using layered, overlapping, uneven lines
Incorporate rough cross-hatching techniques
Lines should feel organic, tangled, expressive, and slightly imperfect
Embrace a sense of controlled chaos and hand-drawn energy
Color Palette (Strictly Minimal):
Skin: flat beige tone only (no gradients, no realism)
Structure & shading: deep black ink strokes only
No smooth blending or polished rendering
Stylistic Details:
Introduce slight asymmetry in line flow for a natural, raw feel
Surround the subject with an irregular, abstract tangled aura made of loose scribbles
Enhance the chaotic energy while maintaining structural clarity
Background:
A solid, flat, vibrant yellow background, clean and uniform, creating strong contrast with the black ink work
Lighting:
Lighting should be implied only through line density—do not use realistic lighting or shading techniques
Overall Look:
High-contrast, graphic, poster-like aesthetic with a raw, expressive ink illustration style
Strictly Avoid:
3D effects
Realistic rendering
Gradients
Soft shading
Any polished or clean digital finish
Style Direction:
Expressive ink illustration / raw sketch poster / abstract line-art portrait
Output Quality:
8K resolution
Aspect Ratio: 4:5

prompts.title: Stern Command
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-quality 4:5 vertical digital illustration based on the provided reference image, transforming the real subject into a bold, gritty, hand-drawn sketch artwork with a powerful street-hip-hop attitude.
Face Match & Identity Accuracy (Critical):

Use the uploaded reference image as the only identity source. Preserve the subject’s facial identity with very high accuracy — exact face shape, forehead, cheekbones, jawline, eyes, nose, lips, skin structure, and overall likeness. The face should naturally adapt to this illustration style while still feeling unmistakably like the real person. Do not let it look like a bad Photoshop edit, pasted face, face swap, or low-quality AI blend. The identity integration must feel seamless, natural, and premium.
Pose & Framing:

Medium-full / upper-body dominant composition with the subject filling most of the frame in a dramatic, slightly low-angle perspective. The head is slightly tilted downward and subtly angled, giving a direct, dominant, confrontational presence. The subject looks straight toward the viewer with a strong attitude.
Expression & Vibe:

Stoic, intense, confident expression with a slightly furrowed brow and a serious, unapologetic rap-icon energy. The final image must feel bold, rebellious, stylish, and full of attitude.
Hand Pose (Important):

The subject’s right hand is thrust forward toward the camera in a finger-gun / pointing gesture, using strong forced perspective so the hand appears oversized and closer than the face. The fingers should feel aggressive, dynamic, and natural — not stiff. The hand must be one of the strongest focal points in the image.
Other Arm & Prop:

The subject’s left hand supports a large vintage boombox resting on the left shoulder. The boombox should feel heavy, iconic, and detailed, with visible speakers, knobs, cassette/radio sections, and metallic texture.
Clothing & Accessories:

Black or very dark Adidas-style track jacket with visible zipper folds and sporty streetwear character

Cool-white inner shirt

Metallic dog-tag chain necklace with realistic pendant shape and chain fall

Bracelet / wrist accessory details

A large watch on the forward hand wrist must be clearly visible and well rendered

Optional subtle tattoo details on wrist/forearm if present in reference
Color Treatment(Critical):

Use a minimal high-impact palette:
Background: saturated vivid red
Linework / jacket / shadows: deep black ink
Skin tone: white
Other light areas like shirt, boombox highlights, reflections, and accessories: cool white, not cream
Art Style:

Raw, energetic graphic novel / sketchbook / urban street-art illustration.

Use:

aggressive black ink drawing

heavy cross-hatching

scribble shading

rough but controlled linework

highly textured rendering

The drawing should feel premium and intentional, not messy in a cheap way.
Lighting:

Strong high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting with bold highlights and deep inked shadows. The face, hand, and boombox should have dramatic depth created through sketch lines and tonal contrast.
Background:

A solid bright red backdrop with chaotic black scribble textures, especially concentrated around the head and upper body like an energy aura. The scribbles should add motion, rawness, and aggression without distracting from the subject.

Quality Control:

The final image must look like a polished, premium illustration conversion — not a cheap edit, not low-resolution, not over-processed, not a pasted face, and not fake-looking Photoshop work. The face should blend perfectly with the illustrated anatomy, perspective, and style.
Overall Result:

A striking, high-energy, attitude-heavy portrait illustration with strong forced perspective, clean identity preservation, and iconic hip-hop poster vibes.
